fact: The PAACOL project, started in 2017 and funded CFAF 743m (EU 656m, AIMF 81m, ANCB 6m), installs single windows for non-tax revenue in 12 communes, each cashier's till equipped with software recording every payment, networked among communal actors.
title: PAACOL
publisher: Association Nationale des Communes du Bénin
